plan.status: Declared before integrated Rust release build and before any Rust speed sampling.
plan.feature: Rust primitive integer conversions and expression context
plan.acceptance: Both CPU and wall median candidate/parent deltas must be at most5% for every case. One final analysis; no unchanged-code repeat after failure. This is the repository median speed criterion; confidence bounds are reported as uncertainty, not used as a hidden post-hoc gate.
plan.confidence_reporting: 95% one-sided paired-block-bootstrap upper bounds on mean CPU/wall ratios,2000resamples per case; not simultaneous bounds. Report alongside medians and retain every sample.
plan.source_revision_note: Same-width primitive signedness conversions, explicit literal-width context, and nested Rust cast angle-boundary grouping. Published Go STORE parent must remain frozen and its actual merged tree must match before Rust publication.

lightwork_reservation_amendment.policy: No concurrent owned builds/tests/decompilations or checkout/evidence finalization; only small static reads/writes pinned reserved CPUs.

plan.raw_sample_persistence: Atomic checkpoint after every balanced block; declared before the first timing sample.
